input.summary: Add Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity, indemnity procedure and IP remedies (new 20.2–20.5); narrow Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently contains only a Customer indemnity for "every claim" relating to use of the Services, with no Vendor indemnity at all, and Section 9.3 already refers to IP remedies in a Section 20.5 that does not exist. We have added the Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breaches and wilful misconduct, together with standard procedure and IP remedies, and narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our own breach of law, consistent with our playbook position.

ops.oldText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from third-party claims to the extent arising out of (a) content or materials Customer provides to Vendor for use in the Services, or (b) Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: 20.2 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to, use, or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

20.3 The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim (delay excusing the indemnifying Party only to the extent it is prejudiced), permit the indemnifying Party to control the defence with counsel of its choice, and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense. The indemnified Party may participate with its own counsel at its own cost. No settlement that imposes a non-monetary obligation, admission of liability, or unreimbursed payment on the indemnified Party may be made without its prior written consent.

20.4 Vendor's indemnity under Section 20.2(a) does not apply to the extent a claim arises from Customer's modification of the Services or Deliverables other than as authorized by Vendor, combination of the Services or Deliverables with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would not have arisen absent the combination, or Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications.

20.5 If an infringement claim is made or Vendor reasonably believes one is likely, Vendor shall, at its expense, procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent non-infringing item. If neither remedy is reasonably available, either Party may terminate the affected Services or Deliverables and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees allocable to the terminated portion together with Fees paid for Deliverables Customer can no longer use.
